name: ring-pm-team
description: Product team workflow: 14 skills + 4 research agents. Pre-dev planning with 4-gate (small features) and 8-gate (large features) orchestrators producing machine-consumable specs (prd, trd, openapi.yaml, schema, plan.md), plus standalone mapping-streaming-events discovery and UX validation. Includes parallel research agents, specialized code analysis, and Product Designer.

interface.shortDescription: Pre-dev planning workflows: PRD, TRD, OpenAPI contracts, schema design, phased plan
interface.longDescription: Structured pre-development workflow. 4-gate orchestrator for small features (<2 days) and 8-gate orchestrator for large features (≥2 days). Each gate produces a versioned artifact (research.md, prd.md, feature-map.md, trd.md, openapi.yaml, schema.sql/schema.prisma, dependencies.md, plan.md) with human approval between gates.
defaultPrompt: Plan a new feature using ring:planning-small-features.
Map the eventable points in this service using ring:mapping-streaming-events.
